title: Jersey
desc: Arjun, a talented but failed cricketer, decides to return to cricket in his late thirties driven by the desire to represent the Indian cricket team and fulfil his son's wish for a jersey as a gift.

title: DSP
desc: After being forced to leave his family due to an altercation with a goon, a man returns as the DSP of his hometown to seek revenge.

title: Sattam Oru Iruttarai
desc: Siblings Vijay and Sheela are in pursuit of the men who killed their father and sister. While Sheela wants to punish them in the court of law, Vijay takes the law into his own hands.

title: Krishna Krishna
desc: Gopalakrishnan, an innocent young man, struggles to reconcile his cunning mother and Bama, his morally upright wife. However, when she suspects him of having bad habits, she decides to leave him.

title: Thaai Manasu
desc: Thangapandi is a revered man in his village and ensures justice and peace prevail. His rival, Kangeyan, brainwashes Thangapandi's elder son and turns him against Thangapandi.

title: Teleshopping
desc: Learn about a wide selection of products and take advantage of a convenient method of shopping. A show for those who love to shop from the comforts of their home.

title: Rudhra
desc: Mayandi kills inspector Gopal and his family except for Rudhra, who finds evidence against him and shows it to the police. However, when an officer begins torturing her, Rudhra vows to kill Mayandi.

title: Thaaye Neeye Thunai
desc: When Seeta suddenly loses her vision on the night of her marriage, she decides to hide the truth from her husband. Trouble ensues when her husband learns about her condition.

title: Vanavil
desc: Surya, Prakash and Priya are three IAS aspirants. When Surya and Priya fall in love, Prakash, Priya's secret admirer, silently becomes an enemy posing as a friend and plots to get rid of Surya.

title: Pathavi Pramanam
desc: Siva breaks out of prison after unsuccessfully trying to kill a politician. He later bypasses the politician's security, kidnaps him, and goes to a television station to reveal his motives.

title: Ammoru
desc: Bhavani is an orphan and an ardent devotee of Goddess Ammoru. The goddess comes to Bhavani's rescue when a vengeful and evil Ghorakh intends to ruin her life.

title: Yes Madam
desc: When Sumati and her son move into the house opposite theirs, Gayatri gets shocked to learn that she is her husband, Sivaramakrishnan's first wife.
